# v1.3.44 — picking a chapter now continues from that chapter

- Fixed: after choosing a chapter from the chapter sheet (or the chapter
  dropdown in the reader settings), finishing that chapter could continue to the
  wrong chapter — for example, jump from Chapter 3 to Chapter 7, and reaching the
  end of Chapter 7 advanced to Chapter 4 instead of Chapter 8. The reader now
  keeps the chapter you selected, so "next" is always the chapter after it.
